Here's exactly how I'd build a digital product, step by step - Copy each prompt below into ChatGPT as you go: 👇 1. Build your Outline 📝 — "Create an outline for a 10-12 page guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Give me a chapter-by-chapter structure with a one-sentence summary for each section." 2. Write it ✍️ — "Write a short, conversational section about [SUBTOPIC]. Keep it simple, include one real-world example, under 250 words." Add your own voice after. 3. Name it — "Give me 10 name ideas for a guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Mix descriptive and punchy, avoid clichés." 4. Design it in Canva 🎨 (a free tool) — search "ebook template," drop your content in, export as PDF. 5. Sell it — upload to Etsy, Stan Store, or Pensight. Want to create and sell digital products? Here's what you actually do. 👇  1. Start with a problem. What problem are you solving for someone else? The best digital products make something easier, faster, or less overwhelming. 2. Create the solution. Turn what you know into something useful—a guide, checklist, planner, workbook, template, printable, mini-course, or resource. 3. Choose where to sell it. You can sell digital products through platforms like Etsy, Teachers Pay Teachers, Stan Store, or your own website. Choose the platform that makes sense for your product and audience. You can also publish them on Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing or Google Play.  4. Market it. Creating the product is only HALF the job. People have to find it! Use Pinterest, TikTok,  email, a blog, or search-friendly content to show people how your product solves their problem. 5. Learn from the first one...then create another. Your first product doesn't have to build financial freedom. It's your starting point. Create one useful product. Learn how to sell it. Improve. Then create another. Over time, you can build a collection of digital products that can be purchased while you're teaching, spending time with family, or simply living your life.  That's what I love about learning skills that can create income from home. I'm not looking for another job. I'm building more ways to earn—and more choices for my future. Financial freedom doesn't have to start with something huge. It can start with one product that solves one problem. Hit the + button if you want to learn more about making money online from home (coming from a full time teacher).  #DigitalProductsForBeginners #ExtraIncomeForTeachers #TeacherSideHustle #MakeMoneyOnline `
